title: Theta-wave rollout playbook (scratch)
content:
Purpose / quick goal:
- Small personal runbook for the Theta-wave release (lightweight canary + cohort priming). This is a scratchpad — not the org runbook.
- Goal: ramp model v2.7 for hosted API w/ minimal user-visible regressions, get 95th-ile latency baseline, and validate cost delta for batching changes.

High-level plan (theta-wave pattern):
- Phase 0: prep & green path (hours -48 to -2)
  - Bake runtime image: traffic-controller@pr879 deployed to staging. smoke test w/ synthetic load.
  - Warm cache: run batch of synthetic requests to populate prefix caches for top 5 routes (chat, generate, embeddings).
  - Notify: #deploys, #eng-serving-runtime, ops oncall. post time window and expected impact.

- Phase 1: shadow + observability (T0) — 0% traffic
  - Enable shadowing for v2.7 for 6h. No routing flip. Collect latency, token-cost, model artifacts.
  - Key queries: long-form chat (>=1024 tokens), short chat, multi-turn w/ KV reuse.
  - Target metrics: p95 latency within +15% of v2.6 baseline; token-cost delta < +8%.

- Phase 2: tethered cohort (T0 + 6h) — 1% 
  - Add cohorts: internal-beta, paid-early (tenants: redwood-internal, partner-x).
  - Duration: 4 hours, continuous monitoring. Slack alerts if spikes > 2x baseline errors or p95 latency > baseline*1.3.
  - Manual checks: read sample outputs every hour for hallucination/formatting regressions.

- Phase 3: slow drip (T0 + 10h) — 1% -> 5% over 12h
  - Linear ramp: 1% -> 2% (3h) -> 3.5% (4h) -> 5% (5h).
  - Canary pin: route flag key: rollout.theta_wave.pin -> SDK flip (see commands below).
  - Warmup cadence: ensure prefix caches persist across instances — check cache-hit rate dashboard.

- Phase 4: broad validation (day+1) — 5% -> 20% if stable
  - Add external small customers. Keep autoscale headroom +25%.
  - Run quality eval set hourly (pre-specified prompts in linked confluence).

- Phase 5: full rollover (day+2) — decision gate
  - If no regressions and cost tolerable, accelerate to 50% then 100% over 24h. Otherwise hold/backoff.

Immediate rollback / escape hatch criteria (call these out):
- Hard rollback triggers (auto):
  - Error rate spike: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m AND request rate >= baseline*0.5
  - Latency: p95 > baseline*1.5 for 10m
  - Cost: token-cost delta > +20% sustained 1h
- Soft rollback (manual): large quality regressions flagged by QA or customer complaints >5 within 1h
- Commands (quick):
  - Flip SDK route (fastest): curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/flags/rollout.theta_wave.pin
    body: {"value": "0.01"}  # change to 0 to kill
  - Re-route to fallback model: curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/route/override -d '{"model":"v2.6"}'
  - Emergency: scale-up dedicated fallback pool: /ops runbook -> escalate to oncall infra

Telemetry & dashboards to watch (quick links in confluence doc above):
- latency-by-route (p50/p90/p95/p99)
- errors-by-route and error-class (model-timeouts vs infra-errors)
- token-cost-per-request and cost-per-tenant
- cache-hit-rate by prefix length and cohort
- output-quality eval: "theta-small-eval" (automated n-gram BLEU-esque + human spot-check queue)

Data collection / artifacts to save:
- save kernel logs for the day of rollout (serving-runtime logs -> s3 path: s3://redwood-ops/rollouts/theta-wave/logs)
- snapshot model config and quantization flags used (model id, docker image sha, kernel selection profile)
- store eval results and sample traces in the confluence runbook page

Open questions / TODO (my quick personal checklist):
- [ ] Confirm whether dedicated pools for partner-x have the same kernel profile (Lina to confirm)
- [ ] Decide on warmup synthetic load size (Sanjay suggested 200 concurrent tiny sessions — check cost)
- [ ] Add a golden prompt set to capture repetitive hallucination classes (write small set)
- [ ] Agree on communication cadence: hourly update in #deploys during phase 1-3, then every 4h

Notes to self (random, keep):
- Watch for token encoder differences between v2.6 and v2.7 that change prompt tokenization (small diff in tokenizer config -> can effect cost)
- If p95 gets flaky during cold starts, consider ramping with a short pre-warm TTL on instance pools
- When pinning via SDK flag, prefer incremental numeric percentages rather than client-side cohort pins (finer control)

Post-mortem anchors (if we end up paginating):
- capture time to rollback, who executed flip, and duration of impact window
- sample 20 failed requests and annotate failure class (model-quality vs infra)
- compute true cost delta normalized by request mix

Quick contacts / channels:
- #deploys (primary)
- #eng-serving-runtime (details & debugging)
- oncall infra: infra-oncall@redwood.ai
- QA: qa-leads@redwood.ai

Final small checklist before starting (T-2h):
- [ ] image pushed to staging and smoke test green
- [ ] routing flag ready and verified in staging
- [ ] slack notifications drafted and scheduled (owner: Avery)
- [ ] golden prompts uploaded to eval queue

-- end scratchpad --

Notes: keep this file lightweight, will consolidate into formal canary runbook if we move forward.
